use_case: TMS document capture: computer vision and a language model read driver-uploaded BOL and POD photos, fill the BOL number and delivery fields, and flag damage or shortage notes before carrier pay and shipper invoicing
vendor_or_model: TMS vendor (document capture feature; vendor-hosted computer vision and language model)
data_categories: BOL and POD images (driver names and signatures, consignee names, seal numbers, exception notes); load and payment records
human_in_the_loop: Owner reads every POD image and confirms the BOL number before approving carrier pay or invoicing; automatic approval off since 2026-08-17
applicable_laws: 49 CFR 371.3(a)(3) and (b) (accurate transaction records); largest shipper's master agreement (data confidentiality); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) where images show personal information

use_case: Carrier monitoring service fraud risk score: a vendor model scores each carrier's likelihood of fraud from registration history, contact changes, and other signals
data_categories: Carrier registration data, contact details, and authority history (public and vendor-collected)
consequential_decision_category: None (commercial carrier selection; many carriers are owner-operators)
human_in_the_loop: Owner uses the score as one input; never the only reason to reject a carrier; reason recorded in the carrier file
applicable_laws: Shipper master agreement (reasonable safeguards); no AI-specific rule identified for this sector
